title: Servicing Policy Manual: Late Charges on the Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Installment Sale Contract
content:
**Servicing Policy Manual — late charges, Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Installment Sale Contract.**

## Clauses in force

1. **Status.** A late charge can be assessed only while the contract status is active or repossession assigned.
2. **Grace period.** A late charge may be assessed only after the product's grace period following the installment due date has fully elapsed. The grace period is counted in calendar days starting the day after the installment due date, weekends and holidays included, so the first permissible assessment date is the calendar day after the due date plus the grace days.
3. **One per installment.** No more than one late charge may be assessed for the same installment due date on the same contract; the test is whether the contract's ledger already shows a late charge for that installment due date.
4. **Cutoff.** A payment that posts after the cutoff on the last grace day posts the next business day and is late.

## Retired clauses

> "The late charge is the late-charge percentage of the unpaid installment portion, capped at the lower of the company maximum late charge and the contract's recorded state maximum late charge."

> "No late charge is assessed when the unpaid portion is less than the minimum unpaid amount for a late charge, on an installment deferred by an extension, or on an installment that was paid in full within the grace period."

Both clauses are **no longer in force** as the handling basis of a late charge; they have been superseded by the company's current late-charge basis.

## The grace period as a time test

| Element | Content |
|---|---|
| Clock starts from | the installment due date shown on the contract |
| Counting | calendar days, day one being the day after the due date, weekends and holidays included |
| Comparison | assessment not before the day after the due date plus the grace days |
| Boundary | the last grace day itself is still within the grace period |

*Boundary cases (abstract):* with a grace period of G days, a late charge may not be assessed on day G after the due date, which is the last grace day; it may be assessed from day G plus 1 onward.

## Term

**Unpaid installment portion:** for the single installment identified by its due date, as of the assessment date, the monthly payment less the payment amounts applied to that installment.

superseded_clauses: The late charge is late_charge_pct_of_unpaid_installment percent of retail_msr_unpaid_installment_portion, capped at the lower of late_charge_company_max and the contract's recorded late_charge_max_amount.

No late charge is assessed when the unpaid portion is less than late_charge_min_unpaid_amount, on an installment deferred by an extension, or on an installment that was paid in full within the grace period.
